en.headline: Paragliding association open to compulsory registration after self-taught pilot injures hikers
en.dek: The Hong Kong China Paragliding Association said it supports real-name registration if it improves safety, after a pilot known to lack formal training struck three hikers at Ma On Shan on Sunday.
body: The Hong Kong China Paragliding Association has said it is open to compulsory registration following a Sunday incident in which a self-taught pilot injured three hikers at Ngong Ping in Ma On Shan Country Park.

Simon Chan Siu-ming, the association’s executive secretary, told a radio programme on Tuesday that fellow pilots had known about the man’s lack of proper training for about nine months and had urged him to seek professional instruction.

Chan said the association would support real-name registration if it brings positive changes for the sport and everyone’s safety. The Civil Aviation Department has operated a voluntary real-name registration and equipment-tag scheme since late 2023.

Police and the Civil Aviation Department are following up on the incident, in which a 42-year-old woman and two teenagers were injured. Personal recreational paragliding does not currently require a licence unless offered for hire or reward.

zh.headline: 滑翔傘協會支持強制登記 自學飛手撞傷行山人士後
zh.dek: 中國香港滑翔傘總會表示，若有助提升安全，樂見強制實名登記；周日一名已知缺乏正式訓練的飛手在馬鞍山昂平撞傷三名行山人士。
body: 中國香港滑翔傘總會表示，周日一名自學飛手在馬鞍山郊野公園昂平撞傷三名行山人士後，協會對強制登記持開放態度。
總會執行秘書陳紹明周二接受電台節目訪問時表示，同好約九個月前已知悉該名男子缺乏正式訓練，並曾勸他接受專業指導。
陳紹明說，若實名登記能為運動及所有人的安全帶來正面改變，協會非常開放。民航處自2023年底起推行自願實名登記及裝備標籤計劃。
警方及民航處正跟進事件，一名42歲女子及兩名少年受傷。個人康樂性質的滑翔傘活動目前無需牌照，除非屬受酬服務。
